candidate_workaround: Construct an explicit PowerShell string array and pass that array to one git add invocation before manifest generation.
failure_signature: A multiline PowerShell command emitted quoted paths as separate expressions, invoked git add with an empty pathspec, and let a manifest build inspect the stale index.
recurrence_guard: For multiline PowerShell staging, bind exact paths to an array, verify the staged path count, and only then run the manifest builder.
rollback: Give the stale-index manifest run zero final credit, retain its wrapper fault, and change no evidence claim until exact array staging passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded shell and Git-index recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use an explicit PowerShell array for exact multiline staging
trigger_preconditions: A multiline staging wrapper supplies an empty pathspec or emits intended paths without staging them.
